title: Herald planning-decision record
description: Canonical record for a planning or sequencing decision — a point where the team resolved which of several paths to take, and what stays open. Distinct from a design-decision (which fixes a code-level contract): a planning-decision fixes a project-state fact, like 'this package is the demo, not that one', and tracks the open work that follows. Prose lives in prose/<repo>/explanation/planning/; this record carries the queryable facts (the decision, the option matrix, the open issues).

context-matrix.description: When the decision turned on comparing several stacks/packages/paths, the matrix that made the choice legible. Each row is one option with the facts that distinguished it.

traps-avoided.description: Specific failure modes this decision steers around — the next person reading this should not re-walk them.

open-work.description: What is planned-not-done after this decision. Each entry names the work, its tracking issue if any, and its honest state.

changes-already-made.description: Edits already landed under this decision that are safe and necessary under any resolution of the open work.

source-doc.description: The working doc whose substance this record lifts, when applicable.
